events.text:
The trader at (44,28) walks to the right door. The trader at (45,31) has to cross open water to the island door at (27,17) by mirror teleports. The other trader moves the mirror between teleports. I worked this out by hand with no checker run, and every step depends on my column count of rows 20–24.

**Key geometry.** The mirror faces west and south. A thing k cells south of it lands k cells west of it, and the reverse also works. So every teleport keeps x − y constant.

- The island needs x − y = 12. The only usable land cell on that diagonal is (43,31).
- That forces this chain of landing points: (43,31) → (47,35) → (33,21) → (53,41) → (28,16).
- The mirror positions for those four hops are (47,31), (47,21), (53,21) and (53,16).
- The three water landing points need sunk crystals as floor. That uses three of the four crystals.
- The mirror at (47,31) can only leave if a trader stands at (47,32). So the fourth crystal is sunk there.
- A trader reaches (47,32) by standing at (46,31) and pressing X, which reflects it onto (47,32).

**Plan.** "Pusher" is the trader starting at (44,28); "hopper" is the one starting at (45,31).

1. The pusher pushes crystal K4 to (47,30), then south twice, so it sinks at (47,32).
2. The hopper pushes the mirror down to (44,31), then east to (47,31).
3. Crystal K3 is pushed down column 43 into (43,31). X throws it to (47,35), where it sinks.
4. Crystal K2 is pushed into (43,31) the same way. X throws it onto the sunk crystal at (47,35).
5. The pusher steps to (46,31) and X sends it to (47,32). It then pushes the mirror north to (47,21) and steps aside. X throws K2 to (33,21), where it sinks.
6. The pusher brings the mirror back down to (47,31). Crystal K1 makes the same trip: to (47,35), then to (33,21), where it rests on the sunk K2.
7. The mirror goes back to (47,31). The hopper steps onto (43,31) and X sends it to (47,35).
8. The pusher uses (46,31) and X again to reach (47,32). It then takes the mirror to (53,21) by way of (48,27) and column 48.
   - X throws K1 to (53,41), where it sinks.
   - The pusher pushes the mirror west to (47,21), and X sends the hopper to (33,21).
9. The mirror goes back to (53,21), and X sends the hopper to (53,41).
10. The pusher pushes the mirror up to (53,16) and steps aside to (54,17). X sends the hopper to (28,16).
11. The hopper walks left and down to (27,17). The pusher steps left onto (53,17), and the level is won.
